instruction: Create an automatic forwarding filter in Thunderbird for all emails received at anonym-x2024@outlook.com to be forwarded to mirror-inbox@zoho.com. Configure this locally in Thunderbird without changing the online account.

metadata.explanation: Variation with different forward target email (mirror-inbox@zoho.com). Evaluator verifies filter is enabled, action is Forward, target is mirror-inbox@zoho.com, and condition is ALL. Same complexity as original.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification: Instruction requires filter for emails 'received at anonym-x2024@outlook.com' but evaluator does not verify the filter checks recipient address
Condition check too loose: Expected condition ['ALL'] does not specify that filter should match emails sent TO anonym-x2024@outlook.com
Missing recipient verification: A proper forwarding filter should have condition like '(to, is, anonym-x2024@outlook.com)' but evaluator only checks for generic 'ALL' condition
Semantic gap: Evaluator verifies forward action and target email correctly, but cannot confirm filter applies to the correct incoming emails
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Update expected condition to include recipient check: condition should contain '(to, is, anonym-x2024@outlook.com)' or similar
Verify the filter applies to emails with 'to' field matching anonym-x2024@outlook.com
Consider checking that 'ALL' means 'match all conditions' AND there exists a condition checking the recipient
Alternative: If 'ALL' means 'all incoming mail', clarify this is insufficient for instruction requirement of emails 'received at' specific address
